title: centrolepis monogyna
intro: Centrolepis monogyna, commonly known as New Zealand pepperwort or swamp pepperwort, is a small, herbaceous plant that belongs to the family Centrolepidaceae. It is native to New Zealand and Australia, and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Centrolepis monogyna include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
